item.title: This S’porean left a 6-year nursing career to be an SCDF paramedic
item.description: An SCDF paramedic shares why she switched from nursing to the frontlines and recalls one of her most unforgettable moments on the job.

item.title: At least 44 dead & nearly 300 missing in fire that engulfed Hong Kong high-rise housing complex
item.description: A fire at a high-rise housing complex in Hong Kong has led to at least 44 dead, at least 45 critically injured, and 279 still missing.

item.title: Hat Yai flood victims seen balancing on electrical cables to cross submerged roads
item.description: A video was uploaded to Facebook showing three Hat Yai flood victims crawling along electrical cables to escape the floodwaters.

item.title: Man claims iPhone 17 Pro Max's paint gets stripped off after cleaning it with wet wipes
item.description: An X user drew attention after claiming that the paint on a man's iPhone 17 Pro Max was stripped off after cleaning it with wet wipes.

item.title: Women's Boot Camp gives 201 participants taste of NS life, includes obstacle course & rifle handling
item.description: Some 201 women stepped into the boots of national servicemen from 21 to 23 Nov, as the sixth edition of the Women’s Boot Camp unfolded.

item.title: Dump truck side-swipes car while changing lane on PIE, spins it 180°
item.description: A dump truck sideswiped a car while changing lanes on the PIE, pushing it to an adjacent lane and spinning it around from back to front

item.title: Stall owner in M’sia finds QR code swapped, perpetrator claims he was ‘borrowing money temporarily'
item.description: A wonton noodles stall owner in Muar, Malaysia, discovered that his QR code had been swapped by a thief who later claimed he was just "temporarily borrowing" the money.

item.title: Rat infestation plagues ABC Brickworks Food Centre, rodents eat food & leave droppings in stalls
item.description: Vendors at ABC Brickworks Market & Food Centre have reported an ongoing rat problem, with their stalls frequently strewn with rat poop.

item.title: Diners at Penang restaurant attacked with knives, received first aid from restaurant staff
item.description: 3 diners were attacked with knives by several men outside a restaurant in Penang on the evening of 22 Nov.

item.title: 'He earned it': S’pore football fans celebrate news of Gavin Lee becoming permanent Lions coach
item.description: The buzz among Singapore football fans is apparent after news broke that Gavin Lee is set to become the permanent head coach of the Lions.
